author: radishmeep
body: I really like that they are trying new things, but this feels like a lot of effort for very little reward, especially as a summoner. There was no reason to play last month's event, and there doesn't seem to be much of a reason to play this one either. Especially with riftbreaks being extremely rare. Hopefully they are able to listen to feedback and tweak these events and turn them into something more enjoyable.

author: cowpow
body:
I believe there's a monster cap associated with your position (that changes depending on different items/gear). If you don't see any event monsters, start clearing out the other monsters and when the count goes under the threshold, a new batch of monsters should appear which should include the event monsters.

You can also click on the title at the top of the screen to see the progress and if you are participating or not.

author: Widogeist
body: I use occult + affinity candle + beast blood + scroll of chaos (for zerks and double drops), works fine for me. Try killing some monsters inside the circle, some of the event monsters should spawn afterwards.  Open the kingdom window then close back out to overworld to force respawns after you've killed a handful of monsters.  The circle will last for the entire hour allowing you to farm event monsters, and despawns once it hits the next hour.  Also you don't have to be directly inside the circle in order to get event monsters to spawn, but you have to be in pretty close proximity.  As a side note, if you're not inside the circle when the riftbreak event "finishes" then I don't think you'll get credit for it (monumental buff) but that's usually not a big deal.

author: dreambig5
body:
This was kind of weird but I think something changed literally in the past 24 hours. I was driving past one of these zones and it somehow allowed me to connect to this event. Even when I drove away, I had the option on the right hand side to return to that location (free of cost but limited time ofcourse). 

When I tapped on that option to go back after getting somewhere safe,  it took me back to this spot. I dropped occult & affinity candles, a torch (plus the usuals like dowsing rod, exp potion, lucky gold, lucky silver) and I got non-stop amount of event monsters. I went at it for 30 mins-ish and gathered enough materials for 20 of the T10 summoning scrolls.
